datasets.name: MIntRec
datasets.version_or_snapshot: repository snapshot used locally; metadata train/test downloaded from official storage, dev not downloaded
datasets.license_or_terms: Repository code is MIT. Dataset/media redistribution terms are not explicitly confirmed in the audited source.
datasets.redistribution_status: not_verified; raw media and downloaded TSVs remain local and ignored
datasets.alignment_statement: The source describes text, audio and video aligned by segment ID; this local run downloaded and validated only text/label TSV metadata, not audio/video presence.

herus_label_mapping.reason: The 20 source labels are outside ARRIVE/HELP/CANCEL; mapping requires new annotation and is not inferred from lexical similarity.

can_prove: Real text/label metadata integrity for the downloaded splits
No duplicate segment IDs between the downloaded train/test splits
Parser out-of-domain rejection/unknown behavior on real English transcripts
cannot_prove: HERUS multimodal convergence, because aligned audio/video were not locally validated
Correctness of an automatic mapping from MIntRec labels to HERUS events

datasets.name: Common Voice Scripted Speech Portuguese
datasets.version_or_snapshot: Scripted Speech v26.0, locale pt, as listed by the official dataset page at audit time
datasets.license_or_terms: CC0 is described by the Mozilla release material for Common Voice data; the exact downloaded package/version must be checked before use or redistribution.
datasets.redistribution_status: version-specific confirmation pending; no files downloaded
datasets.alignment_statement: Each clip is paired with a reference transcript, but the source is not an intent/sensor/multimodal command dataset.

herus_label_mapping.reason: Read speech does not provide HERUS command annotations; no labels are inferred.

can_prove: Potential real-data robustness of an ASR/transcript frontend after a fixed release and permitted download
cannot_prove: HERUS intent coverage without independent annotation

datasets.name: WESAD Wearable Stress and Affect Detection

can_prove: Potential temporal sensor-quality and finite-context experiments after a permitted local download

datasets.name: MInDS-14 Multilingual Spoken Intent Dataset
datasets.version_or_snapshot: Hugging Face revision 40ce77cb32a384e4d50a568e1ec39ac804019d33; config pt-PT; split train
datasets.license_or_terms: The Hub dataset card declares Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC-BY-4.0). Exact terms for the sampled asset and any redistribution/use beyond this local research audit remain a legal gate.
datasets.redistribution_status: source_declared_cc_by_4_0; one small sample fetched locally and deleted; no redistribution
datasets.alignment_statement: The same API row exposes an audio asset, transcription and intent_class. Four offsets were fetched from the same revision and each had all fields; no semantic ASR agreement was measured.

herus_label_mapping.reason: External banking intents are not ARRIVE, HELP or CANCEL; no mapping is inferred from words, slots or labels.

can_prove: Exact Hub revision/config/split and API row identity for the sampled records
Presence and structural validity of four WAV containers paired in the same API rows with transcription and intent_class
C parser fail-closed behavior on the sampled Portuguese transcription bytes
cannot_prove: Audio semantic agreement with transcription because audio was not decoded and no ASR was run
HERUS intent coverage or command correctness without independent annotation
Full-config integrity, speaker independence or physical-device performance

datasets.name: SLURP Spoken Language Understanding Resource Package
datasets.version_or_snapshot: official repository snapshot 8eb16545762be97ace75334109d73824217311f1; text JSONL audited locally; audio not downloaded
datasets.license_or_terms: Textual data CC BY 4.0; audio data CC BY-NC 4.0 according to the original repository LICENSE.txt. The third-party Zenodo record 11106554 declares CC BY 4.0 for its record but does not override the original audio terms.
datasets.alignment_statement: The original package associates JSONL text annotations and audio filenames; this cycle joined text to recording metadata by exact filename, but audio bytes were not loaded and one duplicated filename/reference keeps the join non-unique.

herus_label_mapping.reason: The 93 external intents and 18 scenarios are benchmark labels; no lexical or semantic mapping to ARRIVE/HELP/CANCEL is inferred.

can_prove: Real textual JSONL schema and split integrity
Exact presence of recording filenames in the bounded metadata member
Portuguese HERUS parser coverage/rejection on real English sentences
cannot_prove: Audio waveform correctness or audio-transcript semantic convergence because audio was not loaded
Unambiguous paired alignment because one filename/reference is duplicated
HERUS event convergence without independent annotation
